newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin says holds more dollar auctions.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin says holds more dollar auctions.

text.p: Mexico's largest development bank, Nacional Financiera, said on Thursday that it had completed its tenth short-term dollar auction and its sixth medium and long-term dollar auction.
Of the $53.3 million on offer at the auctions, the development bank assigned $42.7 million at market interest rates set by the winning banks, but it did not give the rates.
Nacional Financiera said that the last auction of the year will be held on December 10.
